title: Mixed Event — A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?! — Episode5 Sudden Trouble

meta.Event: A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!
meta.Event Outline: Not long before White Day, Tsukasa is set to perform as an extra at a facility where visitors can make their own chocolates. Meanwhile, Mizuki has come up with plans for White Day return gifts, and invites Akito along for some chocolate making.

rows.Line: Chocolate Factory

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“*Sob*
*Cry*”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Wh-What's going on?!
Why are you crying, Chocota?! I mean, Hamano?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hold on, is it possible that he banged his pinky against the corner of the table because he can't see very well out of that costume?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Regardless, this is going to make the scene where “the Choco Maniac is so moved by their words that he has no choice but to withdraw” significantly harder to pull off... What do we do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(No, calm down...
I'm a future star. This is my time to shine!)

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“What's the matter, Chocota?!
Why are you crying all the sudden?!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Ah, yes, I see...
You were just that moved by their stories, yes?”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “As was I. These people's stories have compelled me to change my ways.”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “My original intention was to devour delicious chocolates, but now, I'd rather be on the receiving end of one of these gifts...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Splendid! This is going great...!
Now Chocota just needs to say, “As long as you understand. We should be going.” And that'll be it!)

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “A-As long as you understand, Choco Maniac...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Excellent! That's it, Hamano!)

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “Yes, receiving such chocolates is always a wonderful thing...”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“So... Oh no...
*Sob*”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (H-He's crying again?!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Why's he crying like this...?!
What in the world's going on?!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Wait, based on what I've heard so far...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (He's been getting hung up on how these chocolates are a special gift for someone else...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Are you alright, Hamano?!
At this rate, we won't be able to...!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Tenma...!
I know that the show must go on...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: But that boy's story reminded me of something and I haven't been able to stop crying since...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It reminded you of something...?

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: Why's Chocota crying?

rows.Speaker: Adults
rows.Line: I'm not sure. Did something happen to him...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Looks like they're in trouble, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Seems like it.
Something's going on with the guy playing the mascot.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What does Tsukasa plan on doing now...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Hmm... I still don't know why, but Hamano appears to be in no shape to continue... What's my next move?!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What can I do as the Choco Maniac...?)

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“W-Wait, I know what's going on!
Chocota, you not only want to protect everyone's gifts, but you're hoping to receive one, no?”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“If that's the case... Let's see...
Why don't I steal a present for you?!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“N-No, you can't do that!
They're not for you to steal...!
*Sob*”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Gwah!
P-Please stop crying!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Y-You can do it, Tsukasa!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Tsukasa's in a huge bind...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He's been having to ad-lib the whole time while his partner's been down for the count... How's he gonna get out of this one?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: My guess is that he's trying to wrap things up... If I'm right...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Mr. Thief! Over here!
I have an idea!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I-Is that Akiyama...?
Akito's here too! But why...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Fine! I don't have time to think right now! I'll take your bait!)

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “An idea? Tell me more.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It looks like Chocota wants to receive some chocolates from someone, so why don't you make some for him...?

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “What?”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I mean, you love chocolate too, right?
I'm sure Chocota will stop crying if you make some for him, and really put your heart and soul into it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially since we're at the Chocolate Factory! You should be able to make him something really special♪

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Y-Yes, I see.
You certainly have a point.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So why don't we make some chocolates for Chocota once he's settled down a bit? What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“...!
Yes! Let's do that!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Alright, Chocota, we're going to make you some chocolates, so please wipe off those tears.”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Just as our guests here have done, why don't we make some chocolates for ourselves?!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “O-Okay...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Good work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heehee♪
This is sort of my wheelhouse!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness!
They should be able to wrap up the show now!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (But is this really the best way to end this show...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(You're a lifesaver, Akiyama!
Chocota can exit stage left even if he's still crying since it'll look like a happy ending on the surface...!)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Here you are!

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Hm? What's this...?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Everything you need to make chocolates!
You're gonna make some for Chocota, right, Mr. Thief?

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Ah, of course!
But first, we need to...”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh no! Chocota's still crying!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
C-Come back here...!
You can't just interfere like that!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
But he's so sad!
I wanna make something for Chocota too!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
Me too!
Let's make some together, Mr. Thief!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
...
He's still crying...

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Yes, that's a wonderful idea...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Thanks to Akiyama, we can end this show without it being too strange. However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In my book, a happy ending doesn't involve any tears.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Even the little ones seem to understand that!)

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Alright!
Let's make some chocolates for Chocota!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “I mean, I won't be able to get up to my usual antics if he's going to be all weepy!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “So how does making some chocolates with the great phantom thief, the Choco Maniac, sound?!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: You mean it? Yay!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Let's go, Mr. Thief!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wh-Whoa, I wasn't expecting this!
What's Tsukasa gonna do next?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He's really gonna make chocolates while the show's still going? Even though his partner's not exactly back on his feet yet?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah... But the kids are doing a great job of trying to cheer Chocota up, so that's been a pretty big plus.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I don't really have a plan moving forward, but I have no choice but to do what I can...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Regardless, it's a star's job to make everybody smile!! So first...)

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Let's start making some chocolates... Is what I'd like to say, but I only eat them! I have no idea how to actually make them!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Some help would be much appreciated... You there! Why don't you help me make your idea a reality?!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Me?

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Yes, you!
Your friend as well...!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“What do you say?
Willing to lend me a hand?”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Of course...!
I'd love to help, Mr. Thief♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Ugh...
I don't know what you're up to, but we can't really refuse at this point...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, that's...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Those two... I've spoken to them before... I had no idea they were friends...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see...
It's just one coincidence after another.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, Akiyama, Akito, listen up!
I'm going to need your help with this part!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Roger that!
What do you need us to do first?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need you to show me how to make chocolates, Akiyama! I'll follow your instructions as we go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito, you'll need to move Hamano... I mean, Chocota to the green room...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After that, you'll have to find a way to cheer him up enough to get back into acting shape.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's definitely something bothering him, but he also understands that the show must go on...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, I'll try, but no guarantees...
I have no idea if he'll be able to get himself back together in time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I understand. There's no need to force him if he proves too challenging...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: My primary goal is to simply give this show a happy ending. That includes both the guests and the cast.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So please, try your best with him!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Okay, I'll try. But again, no guarantees.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Alright, let's give this show the happy ending it deserves!
